note: Video 008 'The Prison': teal & orange film, an old Islamic city at dusk, night and golden hour. 'world' is the area of sets/city.ts. Transitions: leak (a warm light leak), dissolve, whip (a whip-pan blur on the beat), match (a match cut); every other cut is a hard cut.

shots.why: The Prophet said: through iron-barred gates of an old courtyard at dusk, the Traveller behind them
The world is a prison for the believer: over his shoulder, through the bars, the glittering city
and a paradise for the disbeliever: the bright noisy night market, faceless men laughing and feasting, gold
Because this dunya: tracking alongside him through the market
everything your soul desires: a low angle under the arches, everything shining at him; he keeps walking
You were not created to follow every desire: an empty night street, wet stones, lamps
that passes through your heart: the traffic light turns red; he stops at the line
Sometimes you want something: his hand reaching toward a glowing shop window
but Allah has forbidden it: the hand pulls back
You see something you desire: he lowers his head
but you lower your gaze: the camera follows his eyes down to the wet stones reflecting the lamps
You want to speak: faceless men arguing at a cafe table
but you choose silence: he sits back, quiet, and stands to leave
You want to follow your heart: a crossroads, a neon road toward a party, a quiet road toward a minaret
but you choose what pleases Allah: he turns toward the minaret; birds lift off
You choose modesty: billboards and screens flashing around him
when the world tells you to reveal more: he pulls his scarf closer and walks on
You cover what Allah commanded you to cover: a slow close-up, wrapping his scarf against wind and rain
even when it feels difficult: steady, dignified, in the rain
And this is the struggle: the wind at its strongest, walking against it along the canal
The dunya tells you: Follow what you desire: the market lights pulling at the edges of the frame
But your iman tells you: he walks into the warm lantern-lit masjid courtyard
Follow what Allah loves: doves rising
Every desire you resist for His sake: the red light fading behind him as he walks
...the shop window fading behind him
every temptation you leave behind: the cafe behind him
...the neon road behind him
is another step closer to Jannah: golden hour, his footsteps across the old stone bridge light up gold
Because one day you will enter: on a rooftop at sunrise over the city
a place where nothing you desire will ever be forbidden again: the camera rises into a bright sky full of birds; soft light fills the frame (only light)
